name: Pale Reach: Ealdir Dark Druid's Moonfire deals the percent of maximum health its tooltip states (#9309)
contract: Ealdir Dark Druid (164033) casts Moonfire (365181) on its victim in combat every 10-14 s, first after 2-5 s
(smart_scripts 164033 id 0). Spell 365181 (client and server Spell.dbc identical): effect 1 is Ascension effect
174, 9-10% of the target's maximum health as Arcane damage (BasePoints 8, DieSides 2), effect 0 applies
SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_DAMAGE_PERCENT for 2% of maximum health every 1 s (BasePoints 2, amplitude 1000) for 10 s
(SpellDuration 1). Tooltip: 'Inflicts 9 to 10% maximum health damage ..., then an additional 2% maximum health
damage ... every 1 sec. for 10 sec.' With 20,000 maximum health the hit is 1,800-2,000 (3,000 if critical) and
one full cast stays near 30% of maximum health, far from a one-shot.
